metadata.description: Wayne's custom Claude Code plugin marketplace

plugins.name: linkedin-mcp
plugins.description: Self-hosted LinkedIn MCP server built on the official LinkedIn API (OAuth): profile, create and delete posts

plugins.name: wordpress-mcp
plugins.description: Self-hosted WordPress.com MCP server (REST API, OAuth bearer token): create, update, get, list and delete posts

plugins.name: gmail-mcp
plugins.description: Self-hosted Gmail MCP server (Node, OAuth): search and read threads, list labels and drafts, create drafts. No send or delete

plugins.name: netflix-mcp
plugins.description: Self-hosted Netflix availability MCP server (Node, TMDB API): search titles, check which countries carry a title, browse a country's catalog. Read-only

plugins.name: disney-mcp
plugins.description: Self-hosted Disney+ availability MCP server (Node, TMDB API): search titles, check which countries carry a title, browse a country's catalog. Read-only

plugins.name: prime-video-mcp
plugins.description: Self-hosted Amazon Prime Video availability MCP server (Node, TMDB API): search titles, check which countries carry a title (included, with ads, free, rent/buy), browse a country's catalog. Read-only

plugins.name: marketplace-adapter
plugins.description: Example: share a Claude Code marketplace with OpenCode, Codex and VS Code. Installs plugin skills and MCP servers into those tools via a local adapter page (/marketplace-adapter)
